headline: Website not working can’t change team.
body: Long story short can’t use the app cause my phone won’t update to the version required to run it. Website seems to be working for all other other aspects of Premier League content/draft etc but not the Fantasy Football. Anyone else having this problem? Not ideal 3 hours before deadline when I haven’t looked at it for 2 weeks..   submitted by   /u/Beneficial_Age8919 [link]   [comments]
